label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT observed top-envelope surface

material.note: Observed top-envelope surface derived directly from full-density MT cell-center top points. Vertex colors encode top-point elevation, not resistivity.

source.dataset: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity full-density model
source.classification: source-derived full-density inversion model observed top-envelope surface
source.pointRole: top-most observed source-derived full-density MT cell center per unique XY column

scenePlacement.axisConvention: X east, Y north, Z up

processing.method: Observed top-envelope surface from the full-density MT cell-center tile set. The top-most source point is retained per unique XY column and triangulated directly in observed scene coordinates.
processing.topology: Delaunay triangulation of observed top points only. Triangles with max edge longer than the bridge cutoff are removed. No rectangular support grid, IDW fill, inferred exterior nodes, smoothing pass, uniform regrid, or flattened surface treatment is used.
notes: This is not public topo, lidar, DEM terrain, or measured ground.
This is not an interpreted geological contact, reservoir boundary, well surface, fault, or seismic horizon.
Surface fidelity follows observed MT top-point support: denser areas render finer; sparse extent areas render coarser or remain open.
No exterior fill is fabricated where observed top-point support is absent or too weak.
Visible vertex colors encode top-point elevation for spatial readability; top-contact resistivity values remain scalar metadata.
